components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact oxide action used for submit and primary controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 4px); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The quiet utility action used for theme and return controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 4px); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Compact route links with a thin oxide active mark.
components.html: WritingAboutContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 6px 7px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-active::after { position: absolute; right: 6px; bottom: -2px; left: 6px; height: 1px; background: var(--primary); content: ''; }

components.name: Film Frame
components.description: The signature cover treatment with a film edge, frame number, caption rail, and crop marks.
components.css: .ds-film { width: 360px; margin: 0; padding: 12px 12px 0; background: var(--film); color: var(--film-foreground); } .ds-film-image { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 75%, var(--film)), color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 40%, var(--film))); } .ds-film figcaption { display: grid; height: 24px; grid-template-columns: auto auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--primary); font: 600 10px/1 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-film figcaption span:last-child { justify-self: center; } .ds-crop { position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--primary); } .ds-crop::before, .ds-crop::after { position: absolute; background: currentColor; content: ''; } .ds-crop::before { top: 50%; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; } .ds-crop::after { top: 0; left: 50%; width: 1px; height: 100%; } .ds-crop-a { top: -7px; left: -7px; } .ds-crop-b { right: -7px; bottom: -7px; } .ds-film:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Article Row
components.description: A flat ruled index item with article hierarchy and directional feedback.
components.html: 01初次使用 Astro.js技術文章摘要與閱讀線索。↗
components.css: .ds-article-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 24px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-article-number { color: var(--primary); font: 600 11px/1.25 var(--font-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-article-copy { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; } .ds-article-copy strong { font: 500 24px/1.25 var(--font-serif); transition: color 220ms; } .ds-article-copy small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-sans); } .ds-article-arrow { transition: color 220ms, transform 220ms; } .ds-article-row:hover strong, .ds-article-row:hover .ds-article-arrow { color: var(--primary); } .ds-article-row:hover .ds-article-arrow { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-article-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A full-width archive search held between horizontal rules.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="m20 20-4-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="搜尋..."></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; border-block: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-search input { width: 100%; padding: 16px 16px 16px 28px; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground) 60%, transparent); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: An underline-only serif field with a small technical label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-field span { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 600 10px/1.25 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 18px/1.5 var(--font-serif); transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Reaction Chip
components.description: The intentional pill exception for compact article reactions.
components.css: .ds-reaction { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-reaction span { font-size: 18px; } .ds-reaction small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1 var(--font-sans); } .ds-reaction:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-reaction:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Vartifact treats each article as a selected photographic frame. The visual world joins a working darkroom with a quiet editorial reading room: warm proof paper supports the page, near-black film holds real cover images, and oxide-red registration marks identify active or selected material.

The system is image-first without competing with the writing. Large serif titles and long-form text provide the authored voice; the sans family handles navigation, metadata, controls, and technical indexing. Flat rules, square frames, and restrained motion keep the site precise rather than nostalgic or ornamental.
keyCharacteristics: Real article photography appears in film-edged frames.
Warm proof-paper surfaces replace sterile white.
Oxide red marks selection, links, progress, and action.
Serif reading voice and sans interface voice are the only two type families.
Hairline rules, registration marks, and numbered frames provide structure.

rules.name: The Oxide Mark Rule
rules.body: Oxide red identifies something selected, actionable, or in progress. It is not a large decorative field.

rules.name: The Proof and Film Rule
rules.body: Reading happens on paper-toned surfaces; photography is held by near-black film. Keep this contrast legible in both themes.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Use Noto Serif TC for authored reading and Noto Sans TC for interface structure. Do not add a display or monospaced family.

rules.name: The Caption Discipline Rule
rules.body: Widely tracked uppercase labels stay small and brief; they support the reading hierarchy rather than becoming body copy.

rules.name: The Selected Frame Rule
rules.body: Give one image or article clear priority; supporting frames form a sequence instead of an equal card grid.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Protect prose measure and vertical rhythm before increasing density or decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Proof Rule
rules.body: Static reading surfaces do not float. Elevation communicates interaction or overlay hierarchy only.

dos: Do lead with real article cover images and real writing.
Do pair one selected frame with a supporting sequence.
Do use Noto Serif TC and Noto Sans TC as the complete type system.
Do use hairlines, frame numbers, and registration marks to clarify structure.
Do keep article prose near 65ch and preserve horizontal frame scrolling on mobile.
Do preserve visible focus states, theme parity, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add a third font family, including a separate monospaced label font.
Don't round article images or turn the contact sheet into generic soft cards.
Don't use oxide red as a broad background when a small mark communicates selection.
Don't add shadows to static reading sections.
Don't invent photography, claims, or content when real article material exists.
